system.description:
The Salubri spreads an aura of calm and peace around a small chamber, restraining flaring tempers and reducing arguments to differences of opinion. Vampire lords have used this power to smooth negotiations between mortal and Cainite counterparts alike.

System: The player spends two Willpower points to erect the aura, which lasts as many scenes as the Salubri has dots in her Via rating or until she leaves the area; her third eye opens but sheds no light, so shadowing it changes nothing. This is not a numbing or hypnotic effect — those under its influence are simply more inclined to talk than fight. Anyone under the effect who wishes to insult another or give in to bad temper must roll Willpower (difficulty 8) or subside into mumbling and bewilderment; Brujah are at +2 difficulty on rolls related to aggression while under the effect. The aura works best in a small chamber; a larger chamber (or a banquet hall or sanctuary) spreads and weakens the effect, though the Salubri may spend two more Willpower to extend a small chamber's potency to a larger space. Effects sometimes provoke "buyer's remorse" once they wear off, with mortals reneging on agreements or claiming they were bewitched.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
system.duration: Scenes equal to Via rating, or until the Salubri leaves the area
